title: The Fourth, 2007 · after
logline: The morning after the tourist in the stick-figure shirt: the shirt, left on the dock rail, damp, and Gully folding it and putting it on the high shelf with the lantern. Wood on the steps sees the shelf get one more thing.

panels.composition: The dock rail in the morning with a damp T-shirt on it, a stick figure printed on the front.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a damp t-shirt with a stick figure printed on it hung over a dock rail in morning light

panels.composition: GULLY folding it, carefully, the way he folds nothing else.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron carefully folding a t-shirt

panels.composition: The high shelf: the thermos, the tin, the flag, the lantern, and now the shirt.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a high shelf in a bait shack holding a thermos, a tin, a folded flag, a lantern and a folded t-shirt

panels.composition: WOOD on the steps, BARNABY, looking in at the shelf.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man on shack steps looking in through the door at a high shelf, a small dog beside him

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: The shelf gets one more thing.
